item.title: Health Tidbits Ep 3: Fasting, Fruit Juice and Deep Sleep
item.description: Mimi and Alex distill Raj Shamani's conversation with Dr Vishakha: fasting safely without daily extremes, why fresh fruit juice and jalebi rank worst, deep sleep over sleep hours with a cool room and a two p.m. caffeine cutoff, blood-test-led supplements with omega three only, and five minutes of long-exhale breathing for stress.

item.title: Health Tidbits Ep 2: Why Healthy People Get Heart Attacks
item.description: Mimi and Alex distill Dr Pal's conversation with cardiac surgeon Dr Varun Bansal: why family history matters, how a fit 38-year-old ended up with triple-vessel disease, why the amount of cooking oil matters more than the type, and how an 87-year-old improved with post-meal walks.

item.title: Health Tidbits Ep 1: Sleep Like It Matters — Matthew Walker's Best Ideas
item.description: Mimi and Alex distill Matthew Walker's Diary Of A CEO sleep episode from Naveen's doctor health podcast library: caffeine's three hidden costs, why sleep debt can't be banked, NASA nap rules, sleep and weight loss, and the 2 a.m. playbook.
